Adak

The Aleutian Pribilof Islands Association describes the formation of modern Adak on Adak Island, Alaska, following the closure of the naval station. The City of Adak offers a guide to local organizations and services.

Names & relationships

Selected reading

01

Adak Island and the modern community

The Aleutian Pribilof Islands Association dates the establishment of the modern community on Adak Island to 1998, after the naval station closed. The City of Adak links local organizations, including the Adak Community Development Corporation.
